| Level | Name | Review items that raise it | For an action |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | permissive, strong | nothing | run |
| 1 | permissive, standard | notes (anything not below) | run |
| 2 | conditional | untested:, scope:, evidence: | needs a written reason |
| 3 | interlock | no_breaks:, fixes:, score:, contradiction: | needs a named approval |
| 4 | trip | base:, must_pass:, interlock , eval faulted: | never |

| Constella tier | Loop kind | Epistemic types | Resistance | Needs | Basis label |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| confirmed | conclusion | fact, observation | 0-1 | a receipt: a check against the system, a commit, a benchmark | CONFIRMED |
| asserted | conclusion | fact, observation, rule | 0-2 | the loop's NEEDS-EVIDENCE or a promoted rule without a receipt | CONCLUSION |
| speculative | statement | belief, metaphor | 0-3 | nothing; held as perspective, never applied | STATEMENT |
| refuted | conclusion | fact, observation | 3-4 | a receipt of the negative result; never offered as support | UNKNOWN |

Epistemic types: fact, observation, rule, belief, metaphor (evidenced: fact, observation; perspective: belief, metaphor; default when typed by hand: belief). Verdicts: CONCLUSION, STATEMENT, NEEDS-EVIDENCE, REJECT. Bases, strongest first: CONCLUSION, CONFIRMED, ASSERTED, STATEMENT, SPECULATIVE, BULK, UNKNOWN.
